name: Vipul Organics Limited
about: Vipul Organics Limited manufactures and trades in dyestuffs, organic pigments, and organic intermediates in India. It offers pigment powders, pigment dispersions, reactive dyes, direct dyes, acid dyes, naphthols, fast color bases, fast color salts, vat dyes and pastes, and basic dyes, intermediates for dyestuffs and pigments, and food and lake colors. The company also exports its products. It serves the plastic and master batches, latex, agriculture, leather, paper and packaging, and dietary supplement industries, as well as the food, beverages, and confectioneries. The company was formerly known as Vipul Dyechem Limited and changed its name to Vipul Organics Limited in July 2016. Vipul Organics Limited was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
